title: Microsoft Teams: Channel Agent, a built-in Copilot agent for each Teams channel
summary: Hold: the cost rationale promises no new charge for existing Copilot license holders without a source establishing that for Channel Agent. The creator requirements omit an owner-only restriction, and the Loop disablement note omits the requirement to configure every region. The cited Learn pages opened successfully; their conflicting agent-management instructions are correctly reported.

claims.where: controls[3].scope and note; Governance controls table
claims.claim: IsLoopEnabled is a tenant-wide setting rather than a per-user setting.
claims.quote: This property controls Loop component creation and integration in Microsoft Teams. It applies to the entire tenant and can't be configured at the user level.

claims.claim: Setting IsLoopEnabled to false turns off Loop components in Teams for everyone without regional qualification.

claims.fix: Replace the disablement sentence in both the note and rendered table with: 'Set-SPOTenant -IsLoopEnabled $false disables Loop components in Teams; organizations with multiple regions (organization URLs) must disable them in all regions for consistent results.' Source: https://learn.microsoft.com/microsoft-365/loop/loop-admin-configuration.

claims.claim: Channel Agent interactions use retention policies with Teams chats in Microsoft Purview portal > Data Lifecycle Management > Policies > Retention Policies.
claims.quote: In the Microsoft Purview portal, navigate to Data Lifecycle Management > Policies > Retention Policies and create a retention policy with the following policy location: - Teams chats for interactions with a channel agent

claims.claim: Security & Compliance PowerShell New-RetentionCompliancePolicy -Name <String> -TeamsChatLocation <MultiValuedProperty> creates the policy for the Teams chats location, with a rule required as noted.
claims.quote:
This cmdlet is available only in Security & Compliance PowerShell.
The TeamsChatLocation parameter specifies the Teams users to include in the policy.
Type: MultiValuedProperty

claims.where: controls[4].note; Governance controls table and notes
claims.claim: A retention policy needs a New-RetentionComplianceRule rule before it takes effect.

Cite https://learn.microsoft.com/microsoftteams/manage-apps for that qualification; do not present the Microsoft apps setting as a confirmed way to block Channel Agent.

claims.claim: The Copilot web-search admin controls linked by the setup page govern Channel Agent's web search.

claims.claim: The Allow web search in Copilot policy applies to Microsoft Copilot and Microsoft Copilot Chat.

claims.claim: A Teams DLP policy can scan messages exchanged between Channel Agent and a user.

claims.claim: Channel Agent prompts and responses are captured in the unified audit log.
claims.quote: Like other activities, prompts and responses are captured in the unified audit log.

claims.claim: Loop report storage uses organizational SharePoint storage, supporting the storage-cost premise.
claims.quote: Loop components and their integrations are powered by .loop files (earlier releases created .fluid files), stored in OneDrive, SharePoint, or SharePoint Embedded. Storage counts against your organization's SharePoint quota.

claims.fix: The After rollout instruction to search Audit has no corresponding controls-table row. Remove that checklist bullet to reconcile the checklist with the existing table without adding an unverified control row.
